items.text: Oruzaaro rwa Leevi
Runu nurwo oruzaaro rwa Leevi: Geresoomu, Kohasi na Merali.
Banu nubo batabani ba Kohasi: Amuraamu, Izihaara, Hebburooni na Uzyeri.
Banu, nubo baana b'Amuraamu: Arooni, Musa na Miryamu. Banu nubo batabani b'Arooni: Nadabbu, Abbihu, Eryeza na Itamara.
Eryeza akazaara Fenehaasi, Fenehaasi yazaara Abbisuwa,
Abbisuwa yazaara Bbuuki, Bbuuki yazaara Uzi,
Uzi yazaara Zerahiya, Zerahiya yazaara Merayoosi,
Merayoosi yazaara Amaliya, Amaliya yazaara Ahitubbu,
Ahitubbu yazaara Zadooki, Zadooki yazaara Ahimaazi,
Ahimaazi yazaara Azaliya, Azaliya yazaara Yohanaani,
Yohanaani owa Azaliya (ogu nuwe yaheeriize nkanyakatagara, omunju Solomooni ei yayombekere Yerusaalemu).
Azaliya akazaara Amaliya, Amaliya yazaara Ahitubbu,
Ahitubbu yazaara Zadooki, Zadooki yazaara Salumu,
Salumu yazaara Hirekiya, Hirekiya yazaara Azaliya,
Azaliya yazaara Seraaya, Seraaya yazaara Yehozadaki,
MUKAMA obu yazaahisize Yuda na Yerusaalemu, baatwarwa Nebbukadaneeza, Yehozadaki ogu nawe, nubwo yazaahisibwe.
Kurug 6:16-19
Banu nubo batabani ba Leevi: Geresoomu, Kohasi na Merali.
Kandi ganu nugo amabara ga batabani ba Geresoomu: Libbuni na Simeyi.
Banu nubo batabani ba Kohasi: Amuraamu, Izihara, Hebburooni na Uzyeri.
Banu nubo batabani ba Merali: Mahiri na Musi. Ebi nibyo ebitabu eby'Abaleevi baisenkurubo nkooku bakaba bali.
Banu nubo batabani ba Geresoomu: mutabani we, nuwe Libbuni, Libbuni akazaara Yahasi, Yahasi yazaara Ziima,
Ziima yazaara Yowa, Yowa yazaara Ido, Ido yazaara Zeera, Zeera yazaara Yeyaserayi.
Banu nubo batabani ba Kohasi: Aminadabbu, Koora, Asiri,
Erikaana, Ebyasaafu, Asiri,
Tahasi, Uryeli, Uziya, Sahuli.
Banu nubo batabani b'Erikaana: Amasayi n'Ahimoosi,
Erikaana, Zofayi, Safayi yazaara Nahasi,
Eryabbu, Yerohaamu, Erikaana.
Banu nubo batabani ba Samwiri: Yoweri nuwe omuzigaijo gwe, omusubiro nuwe Abbiya.
Banu nubo batabani ba Merali: Mahiri, Libbini Simeyi, Uza,
Simeya Hagiya, Asaaya!
Abazini abaakomerwe Daudi kuzinira omunju ya Ruhanga
Esanduuko ey'Endagaano ya MUKAMA obu yamazire kutaaha omunju ya MUKAMA, banu nubo abasaija Daudi aba yakomere, yabaha omulimo ogw'okuziniramu.
Okuhika Solomooni obu yakamazire kwombekera MUKAMA enju Yerusaalemu, abo nubo baaheerezaaga, nibazina omumaiso g'eheema ey'okutangatanganiramu; kandi omulimo gwabu, baagukoraga omu mbu.
Banu nubo abasaija abaaheerezaaga, hamu na batabani baabo. Ha batabani ba Kohasi-Hemani omuzini, mutabani wa Yoweri, Yoweri mutabani wa Samwiri,
Samwiri mutabani w'Erikaana, Erikaana mutabani wa Yerohaamu, Yerohaamu mutabani w'Elyeri, Elyeri mutabani wa Towa,
Towa mutabani wa Zuufi, Zuufi mutabani w'Erikaana, Erikaana mutabani wa Mahaasi, Mahaasi mutabani w'Amasayi,
Amasayi mutabani w'Erikaana, Erikaana mutabani wa Yoweri, Yoweri mutabani w'Azaliya Azaliya mutabani wa Zefaniya,
Zefaniya mutabani wa Tahasi, Tahasi mutabani w'Asiri, Asiri mutabani w'Ebyasaafu, Ebyasaafu mutabani wa Koora,
Koora mutabani wa Izihaara, Izihaara mutabani wa Kohasi, Kohasi mutabani wa Leevi, Leevi mutabani wa Isirairi,
kandi owanyina ayayetwaga Asafu, nuwe yamwemerraga ha mukono gwe ogw'obulyo, Asafu mutabani wa Bberekiya, Bberekiya mutabani wa Simeya
Simeya mutabani wa Mikairi, Mikairi mutabani wa Bbaaseya, Bbaaseya mutabani wa Malikiya,
Malikiya mutabani wa Esini, Esini mutabani wa Zeera, Zeera mutabani w'Adaaya,
Adaaya mutabani w'Esaani, Esaani mutabani wa Ziima, Ziima mutabani wa Simeyi,
Simeyi mutabani wa Yahasi, Yahasi mutabani wa Geresoomu, Geresoomu mutabani wa Leevi.
Ha mukono gwabu ogw'obumoso, haayemerrahoga bagenzi baabo, batabani ba Merali, nubo banu: Esaani mutabani wa Kiisi, Kiisi mutabani w'Abbudi; Abbudi mutabani wa Maluki,
Maluki mutabani wa Hasabbiya, Hasabbiya mutabani w'Amaziya, Amaziya mutabani wa Hirikiya,
Hirikiya mutabani w'Amuzi, Amuzi mutabani wa Bbaani, Bbaani mutabani wa Semeri,
Semeri mutabani wa Mahiri, Mahiri mutabani wa Muusi, Muusi mutabani wa Merali, Merali mutabani wa Leevi.
Kandi bagenzi baabo Abaleevi, bbo bakakomerwa omulimo gwona ogw'omunju ya Ruhanga.
Oruzaaro rw'Arooni

Baitu Arooni na batabani be, nubo baahongaga ebihongwa haitambiro ery'ebihongwa eby'okwokya, na ha itambiro ery'okucumikirirraho obubbaani obw'omulimo gwona ogw'omu kiikaro kyona ekirukwerra kimu okukira byona, n'okuleheerra Isirairi, nibahikiriza byona, Musa omuhereza wa MUKAMA ebi yaragiire.
Banu nubo batabani b'Arooni: Mutabani we nuwe Eryeza, Eryeza mutabani wa Fenehaasi, Fenehaasi mutabani w'Abbisuwa,
Abbisuwa mutabani wa Bbuuki, Bbuuki mutabani wa Uzi, Uzi mutabani wa Zerahiya,
Zerahiya mutabani wa Merayosi, Merayosi mutabani w'Amaliya, Amaliya mutabani w'Ahitubbu,
Ahitubbu mutabani wa Zadooki, Zadooki mutabani w'Ahimaazi.
Embuga z'Abaleevi
Binu nibyo ebiikaro byabo baikaramuga, noogendera ha biikaro ebinyakuli omunda y'emitaano yabu. Batabani b'Arooni ab'ebitabu eby'Abakohasi, abo habwokuba nubo baakwasirwe itomo,
bakaba ha Hebburooni ey'omunsi ya Yuda, n'ensi ez'amaliisizo eziherraineho,
baitu emisiri ey'orubuga n'ebyaro byarwo, baabiha Kalebbu mutabani wa Yefune.
Batabani b'Arooni, bakabaha embuga ez'okusingirwamu, nizo zinu:
Hebburooni, Libbina, n'amaliisizo garwo, Yatiri, Esitemowa n'amaliisizo garwo, Debbira n'amaliisizo garwo.
Asani n'amaliisizo garwo na Bbesi-semesi n'amaliisizo garwo;

kandi ezaarugire omu ruganda rwa Benyamiini, Gebba n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Alemeesi n'amaliisizo garwo, n'Anatoosi n'amaliisizo garwo. Embuga zaabo zoona ezagabiirwe ebitabu byabo, Zikahika ikumi na isatu.
Batabani ba Kohasi abaasigaireho, bakaheebwa embuga ikumi ezaihirwe omu nganda ez'ihanga eri, ezaihirwe omu ruganda orw'ekicweka, nikyo ekicweka ekya Manaase.
Abageresoomu, ebitabu byabo nkooku biri, bakaheebwa embuga ikumi na isatu, ezaihirwe omu nganda za Isakaara ez'Aseri, Nafutaali, n'eza Manaase ez'omu rubuga Basani.
Abameraali, ebitabu byabo nkooku biri, bakaheebwa embuga ezaihirwe ha nganda eza Rubbeni, Gaadi, na Zabbulooni.
Abantu ba Isirairi, nukwo baahaire bati Abaleevi, embuga hamu n'amaliisizo gaazo.
Kandi bakabaha embuga ezi, ezigambirwe amabara, ezaihirwe ha nganda za Yuda, Simyoni na Bbenyamiini, nibateera akaruuru.
Kandi ebimu ha bitabu bya batabani ba Kohasi bakatunga embuga ez'ensi yabu ezaihirwe ha ruganda rw'Efuraimu.
Bakaheebwa embuga ez'okusingirwamu, nizo zinu: Sekemu orunyakuli omunsi ey'ensozi ey'Efuraimu, hamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Gezere hamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo,
Yokimeyamu hamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Bbesi-horoni hamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo,
Aiyaroni hamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Gasi-rrimoni, hamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo,
kandi ha ruganda orw'ekicweka orwa Manaase, bakatunga Aneri n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Bbileyamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo, ezi, zikahebwa abaasigaireho ha bitabu by'Abakohasi.

Ab'oruganda rwa Geresoomu bakaheebwa embuga ezaihirwe ha ruganda orw'ekicweka eky'oruganda rwa Manaase, nizo zinu: Gorani orunyakuli Bbasani, hamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Asitarosi, hamu n'amaliisizo gaarwo,
kandi ezaihirwe ha ruganda rwa Isaakaara, bakaheebwa Kedesi n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Dabberasi n'amaliisizo gaarwo,
Rramosi n'amaliisizo gaarwo, n'Anemu n'amaliisizo gaarwo;
ha ruganda rw'Asere, bakaheebwa Masaali n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Abudoni n'amaliisizo gaarwo,
Hukoku n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Rehobbu n'amaliisizo gaarwo;
kandi ha ruganda rwa Nafutaali, bakaheebwa: Kedesi, orunyakuli Galiraaya n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Hamoni n'amaliisizo garwo, Kiryasahimu n'amaliisizo gaarwo.
Abasigaireho ha Bameraali, bakaheebwa embuga zinu ezaihirwe ha ruganda rwa Zabbulooni: Rrimono n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Tabora n'amaliisizo gaarwo,

kandi obuseeri bwa Yorudaani haihi na Yeriko, ha rubaju orwa Burugaizooba orwa Yorudaani, bakaheebwaho zinu, ezaihirwe ha ruganda rwa Rubbeni: Bbezere orw'omwirungu n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Yahaza n'amaliisizo gaarwo,
Kedimosi n'amaliisizo gaarwo, na Mefasi n'amaliisizo gaarwo;
kandi ezaihirwe ha ruganda rwa Gaadi, bakahebwa zinu: Rramosi orw'omunsi Giryadi n'amaliisizo gaarwo, Mahanaimu n'amaliisizo gaarwo,
Hesibboni n'amaliisizo gaarwo, na Yazere n'amaliisizo gaarwo.
